provenance_and_validation_text.text: The independent fixture source and its exact JSON receipt are work/tau_arithmetic_determinant_transport_exact_fixtures_20260913.py and the same basename with .json. The calibration retains the literal original Gamma coordinate \(S=1/2+iu\) and mass \(\sqrt{2\pi}\), takes the test relation \(\chi=S^2-S+3/16\), and compares that Gamma density with \((u^2+u/3+2)m_0(u)\). This latter multiplier is positive since it is \((u+1/6)^2+71/36\), and it is unbounded. Its mass is \(5\sqrt{2\pi}/2\). The test relation is explicitly a calibration polynomial, not a zero-packet assertion.
